trips.route_note: Frequent direct SJ or commuter trains run from Stockholm Central to Uppsala Central in well under an hour, with the sights a short walk from the station.
trips.why: Direct trains take only 30 minutes and run 87 times a day, dropping you a short walk from the sights.
know: Book ahead for the fastest SJ departures
Uppsala Cathedral and the university area are walkable from the station
Spring and summer are best for wandering the old town
